e.summary: **Development and validation of a machine learning-based claims frailty index**（PMID `42785600`；*Exp Gerontol.* 2026 Sep 24:113338）**是一篇**用**台湾**健保**理赔**库**建 **ML** 虚**弱**指**数**的**论文****——**逐字标题**为**「**Development and validation of a machine learning-based claims frailty index for predicting mortality, disability, and healthcare utilization in middle-aged and older adults**」**。**本次实测**：**⭐ 电子**出版日 **2026-09-24****（**窗口内）**、**状态**逐字 **`Online ahead of print`****、**DOI **`10.1016/j.exger.2026.113338`****、**作者逐字 **`Hwang AC`／**`Tseng SF`／**`Chen LK`／**`Hsiao FY`／**`Chen LY`／**`Lin MH`／**`Peng LN`****。**⭐⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**新面 **PubMed（**健康**保险**线）」**，**并**补上**本站**最薄的一栏**——**健康保险**（**实测**本轮**之前**仅 **2** 条**）**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四处最值得看**：**① **它**的**起**点**是**对**已**有**方**法**的**一**个**具**体**批**评****——**⭐ 逐字**：**「**Most existing claims-based frailty indices (CFIs) rely primarily on diagnostic codes, which may overlook functional status reflected in healthcare utilization.**」**——**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**对 **RIAA** 最有用**：**⭐ 即**「**只看**诊**断**码」**与**「**看**就**医**行为」**的**区别**：**前**者**告**诉**你**「**得**了**什么**病」**，**后**者**才**反**映**「**身体**撑**不**撑**得**住」**（**⭐ 门**诊**频**次、**住**院**天**数、**用**药**强**度）**；**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**做**健**康**险**或**寿**险**的**风**险**分**层**时**，**把**「**利用**度」**（**utilization）**与**「**诊断」**当**成**两**类**不同**信号**，**而**不**是**只**取**诊**断**；**② **它**的**建**模**路**径**逐字**清晰**可**抄**：**`1032 candidate variables` → **`age-associated items` → **`extreme gradient boosting model`（**`5-fold crossvalidation`）** → **`63-item CFI`****——**⭐ 即**「**先**大**候选**集、**再**按**年**龄**相关**筛、**再**用 **XGBoost** 拟**合**调查**量表**、**最**后**收**敛**到 **63** 项**指标**」**；**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**这**是**「**用**可**观**测**的**理赔**特征**去**逼**近**不**可**观**测**的**功能**状态」**的**标准**做**法**（**⭐ 而**参**照**标**准**是**调**查**量**表，**故**两**者**可**对**照**）；**③ **它**的**结果**报**法**可**直接**引**用**（**逐字**：**adjusted HR 1.44-1.81, 95% C.I 1.31-2.31** 与 **ΔAUC ranging from 2.79% to 6.90%; P < 0.05**）**——**⭐ 即**同**时**给**出**「**绝**对**风**险**比」**与**「**相对**既**有**指**数**的**增益」**，**而**不**只**报 **AUC**；**④ **它**的**可**复**现**前**提**也**写**得**清**楚**（**开**发**队**列 **2011** 年 **n = 3,727**、**验**证**队**列 **2015** 年 **n = 5,434**，**死**亡 **723／**580** 例）**。**⚠️ 本次**未读**其**正文**、**未**复**现**其**任何**模型**。
e.body:
**Development and validation of a machine learning-based claims frailty index**（PMID `42785600`；*Exp Gerontol.* 2026 Sep 24:113338）**是一篇**用**台湾**健保**理赔**库**建 **ML** 虚**弱**指**数**的**论文****——**逐字标题**为**「**Development and validation of a machine learning-based claims frailty index for predicting mortality, disability, and healthcare utilization in middle-aged and older adults**」**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**新面 **PubMed（**健康**保险**线）**」**。
**可核实信息（均 2026-09-27 PubMed E-utilities 实测）**：
**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它**的**起点**是**对**已**有**做**法**的**一**个**具**体**批**评**，**而**这**个**批**评**本**身**就**是**可**迁**移**的**建模**直觉****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**摘要**逐字**写**「**Most existing claims-based frailty indices (CFIs) rely primarily on diagnostic codes, which may overlook functional status reflected in healthcare utilization.**」**；**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**对 **RIAA** 最有用**：**⭐ 即**理**赔**数**据**里**至少**有**两**类**信号**——**「**诊**断**码」**告**诉**你**得**了**什么**病**，**而**「**利用**度」**（**就**医**频次**、**住院**天**数**、**用**药**强度）**反**映**身**体**能**不**能**撑**住**；**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**做**健**康**险**或**寿**险**的**风**险**分**层**时**，**先**把**这**两**类**信号**分**开**列**出来**，**再**决**定**用**哪**些**（**⭐ 与**第 **380** 轮**记下的**「**把**法**定**上限**当**截断**点」**同**属**「**数据**里**的**结构**性**信息**要**先**用**上」）**。
**⭐⭐ ② 它**的**建**模**路**径**逐字**清楚**可**抄**（**先**大**候选**集、**再**按**年**龄**相**关**筛、**再**用 **XGBoost** 学**调查**量表、**最**后**收**到 **63** 项）****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**摘要**逐字**写**「**Among 1032 candidate variables, age-associated items were identified and entered into an extreme gradient boosting model (internally validated by 5-fold crossvalidation) to predict the SFI, yielding a 63-item CFI.**」**，**并**逐字**说明**参**照**标**准**为 **`The TLSA survey-based frailty index (SFI) served as the reference standard.`****；**⭐ 本词条**据此**指出**：**⭐ 即**这**是**「**用**可**观**测**的**理**赔**特征**去**逼**近**不**可**观**测**的**功能**状态」**的**标准**范**式**——**⭐ 而**它**的**关**键**是**有**一**个**独**立**测**量**的**参**照**标**准**（**调**查**量**表）**可**以**对**照**；**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**做**这**类**「**代理**变量」**建模**时**，**若**没**有**参**照**标**准**，**就**只**能**说**「**相关」**而**不**能**说**「**测得**准**」**。
**⭐⭐ ③ 它**的**结**果**报**法**同**时**给**「**绝**对**风险」**与**「**相对**既**有**指**数**的**增益」****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**摘要**逐字**写**「**Each 0.1-point increase in CFI was associated with higher 1-, 3-, and 5-year mortality (adjusted HR 1.44-1.81, 95% C.I 1.31-2.31), with discrimination comparable to the SFI. Higher CFI scores were also associated with increased risks of healthcare utilization and disability, with discrimination exceeding that of an established multimorbidity frailty index (ΔAUC ranging from 2.79% to 6.90%; P < 0.05).**」**；**⭐ 本词条**据此**指出**：**⭐ 即**它**没**有**只**报 **AUC**，**而**是**同**时**给**出**「**每 **0.1** 分对应**的**死**亡**风**险**比**区**间」**与**「**相**对**既**有**指**数**的 **ΔAUC」**——**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**报**告**新**指**数**时**，**至**少**要**给**这**两**类**数**字**（**绝**对**关**联**＋**相**对**增**益）**，**否**则**读**者**不**知**道**它**到**底**有**多**大**用**。
**⭐⭐ ④ 它**写**明**了**可**复**现**前**提**（**两**个**队**列**的**年**份**、**样本**量**与**死**亡**例**数**）****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**摘要**逐字**写**「**The 2011 cohort (n = 3727) was used for development and the 2015 cohort (n = 5434) for validation.**」**与**「**723 and 580 deaths occurred in the development and validation cohorts, respectively.**」**，**并**逐字**说明**统**计**方**法**为 **`Cox models adjusted for age, sex, and comorbidity burden`****；**⭐ 本词条**据此**指出**：**⭐ 即**「**开**发**队**列**与**验**证**队**列**来**自**不**同**年**份」**是**一**种**时**间**上**的**外**部**验**证**（**⭐ 而**不**是**同**一**批**数据**随**机**切**分）**——**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**做**模**型**报**告**时**，**若**能**用**「**后**来**的**年**度」**做**验**证**，**比**随**机**切**分**更**接**近**实**际**部**署**。
**⭐⭐ ⑤ 元数据**、**出**处**与**窗口**（**⭐ 含 **PubMed** 检索**的**一**条**口径**判**据）****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**PubMed** 记录**逐字**给出 **PMID **`42785600`**、**期**刊 **`Exp Gerontol.`**、**日**期行 **`2026 Sep 24:113338`**、**`Online ahead of print`** 与 **DOI **`10.1016/j.exger.2026.113338`****；**⭐ 本词条**如实**指出**：**⭐ 即**本**轮**的**检索**用 **PubMed** 的 **`edat`（**Entrez** 入**库**日）**做**窗口**过**滤**，**而**记录**里**还**有 **`pubdate`（**出**版**日**期**行）****——**⭐ 二**者**可**以**不**同**（**⭐ 本**轮**另**有**一**条**命中**的 **`pubdate`** 为 **`2026 Dec 31`**，**而 **`edat`** 在**窗口内）**，**故**引**用**时**要**写**明**用的**是**哪**个**日期**（**⭐ 与**第 **379** 轮**「**注册**日 **≠ **出版日」**同**类）**。
**⭐⭐ ⑥ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[vhis-standard-premium]] 覆盖**台**湾**健保**的**保费**结构**、**[[tii-taiwan-insurance]] 覆盖**台**湾**保险**业**统计**、**[[health-insurance-reserving-handbook]] 覆盖**健**康险**准备金**——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**以**台湾健保**理赔**库**建 **ML** 虚**弱**指**数**并**与**调查**量表**对照**」这一**形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较**。
**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 五件事值得借**：**① **把**「**诊断」**与**「**利用度」**当**两**类**信号**；**② **用**观**测**特征**逼**近**不**可**观**测**状态**时**要**有**参**照**标**准**；**③ **结**果**同**时报**绝**对**关**联**与**相**对**增**益**；**④ **优**先**用**后**来**年**度**做**验**证**；**⑤ **说**明**用**的**是**入**库**日**还**是**出**版**日**。
**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有阅读**其**正文**、**未**获**取**其**模**型**或**数**据**、**未**复**现**其**任何**结**果**，**故**不**主张**其**模**型**性**能**、**指**数**构**造**合理**性**或**临**床**有效**性**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只读**PubMed** 记录**接口**返回的**元数据与摘要**（**经 **E-utilities **`esummary`／**`efetch`）**，**未读**其**全文**（**⭐ 该**刊**为**订**阅**制，**本**词条**未**尝**试**获取**全文）**。**③ ⚠️ **未核实**其**在**台湾**健保**数据**上的**样本**代表**性**与**外**部**推**广**性**。**④ ⚠️ **未核实**其 **63** 项**指标**的**具体**内容**与**可**得**性**。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核实**其**与**既**有**多**病**共**存**虚**弱**指**数**的**比**较**细**节**。**⑥ ⚠️ **未核实**其**是**否**有**代码**或**数**据**可**申**请**。**⑦ ⚠️ 窗口**状况**：**电**子**出版**日 **2026-09-24** 落在**本轮**窗口**之内**（**基准日 **2026-09-27）**，**故**无需**缺口**说明**；**⭐ 而**其**期**刊**卷**期**为 **`2026 Sep 24:113338`**（**在**线**先**发**）。**⑧ ⚠️ 本条目**所记为 **2026-09-27 所见**；**⚠️ 涉**及**健康**保险**风**险**分**层**，**⚠️ 不**构成**任何**医**疗**、**核**保**或**定**价**建议**。
e.verified_note: 实测核实（2026-09-27）：① PubMed E-utilities 检索 https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/esearch.fcgi?db=pubmed&term=health+insurance+claims+prediction&mindate=2026/09/05&maxdate=2026/09/25&datetype=edat&retmode=json 返回 200，count 5，本条 PMID 42785600 在其中 ② esummary 逐字：title Development and validation of a machine learning-based claims frailty index for predicting mortality, disability, and healthcare utilization in middle-aged and older adults、pubdate 2026 Sep 24、source Exp Gerontol.、authors Hwang AC, Tseng SF, Chen LK, Hsiao FY, Chen LY, Lin MH, Peng LN、elocationid doi: 10.1016/j.exger.2026.113338 ③ efetch（rettype=abstract, retmode=text）返回 200，逐字含 Exp Gerontol. 2026 Sep 24:113338. doi: 10.1016/j.exger.2026.113338. Online ahead of print. 与 OBJECTIVES: Most existing claims-based frailty indices (CFIs) rely primarily on diagnostic codes, which may overlook functional status reflected in healthcare utilization. We therefore developed and externally validated a machine learning-based CFI 与 with the National Health Insurance Research Database, including participants aged ≥50 years. The TLSA survey-based frailty index (SFI) served as the reference standard. The 2011 cohort (n = 3727) was used for development and the 2015 cohort (n = 5434) for validation. Among 1032 candidate variables, age-associated items were identified and entered into an extreme gradient boosting model (internally validated by 5-fold crossvalidation) to predict the SFI, yielding a 63-item CFI. Associations between the CFI (per 0.1 increment) and outcomes were assessed using Cox models adjusted for age, sex, and comorbidity burden. 与 RESULTS: 723 and 580 deaths occurred in the development and validation cohorts, respectively. Each 0.1-point increase in CFI was associated with higher 1-, 3-, and 5-year mortality (adjusted HR 1.44-1.81, 95% C.I 1.31-2.31), with discrimination comparable to the SFI. Higher CFI scores were also associated with increased risks of healthcare utilization and disability, with discrimination exceeding that established multimorbidity frailty index (ΔAUC ranging from 2.79% to 6.90%; P < 0.05). 与 CONCLUSIONS: A machine learning-derived CFI integrating diagnoses, medications, and procedures demonstrated robust prediction of mortality and other adverse outcomes, supporting its incremental value in population-based frailty assessment. 与 Copyright © 2026. e.title_en: A paper that builds a machine learning frailty index from a national health insurance claims database: it starts from the criticism that most existing claims-based frailty indices rely primarily on diagnostic codes and may therefore overlook functional status reflected in healthcare utilisation, then moves from a large candidate variable set through an extreme gradient boosting model with cross-validation to a sixty-three item index whose association with mortality is reported as an adjusted hazard ratio band per increment and whose discrimination exceeds an established multimorbidity frailty index by a stated margin.
e.title_hk: **一**篇**用**台**灣**健**保**理**賠**庫**建 ML 虛弱指數的論文****：`claims-frailty-index`——**⭐ 逐字標題為**「**Development and validation of a machine learning-based claims frailty index for predicting mortality, disability, and healthcare utilization in middle-aged and older adults**」**；**⭐ 起點逐字是一個批評**：**「**Most existing claims-based frailty indices (CFIs) rely primarily on diagnostic codes, which may overlook functional status reflected in healthcare utilization.**」**；**⭐ 方法逐字為 `1032 candidate variables` → `extreme gradient boosting model`（**5 折交叉驗證）** → `63-item CFI`**；**⭐ 結果逐字為 `adjusted HR 1.44-1.81`（**每 0.1 分）與 `ΔAUC ranging from 2.79% to 6.90%`**
e.summary_en: This paper builds a machine learning frailty index from a national health insurance claims database, and its title names development and validation for predicting mortality, disability, and healthcare utilisation in middle-aged and older adults. **Measured this round**: electronically published on the twenty-fourth of September inside the window and still online ahead of print, with a persistent identifier and seven named authors. **This round theme is a new surface in a health insurance line, and this entry fills one of the thinnest categories on the site, which held two entries before this round.** **Four things are worth reading: its starting point is a specific criticism of existing practice, namely that most existing claims-based frailty indices rely primarily on diagnostic codes and may therefore overlook functional status reflected in healthcare utilisation, which matters because diagnostic codes say what disease a person has while utilisation reflects whether the body is coping, through visit frequency, hospital days, and medication intensity, so health or life risk stratification should treat utilisation and diagnosis as two distinct signal families; its modelling path is stated clearly enough to copy, moving from more than a thousand candidate variables through age-associated items into an extreme gradient boosting model with cross-validation and finally to a sixty-three item index, which is the standard way to approximate an unobservable functional state using observable claims features, with a survey instrument as the reference standard; its results are reported in a directly citable way, giving both an absolute association as an adjusted hazard ratio band per increment and a relative gain over an established multimorbidity frailty index as a difference in discrimination, rather than reporting a single discrimination statistic; and its reproducibility preconditions are explicit, naming the development and validation cohorts with their sizes and the number of deaths in each.** **The paper text was not read and no model was reproduced this round.**

This paper builds a machine learning frailty index from a national health insurance claims database. **This entry belongs to the round theme of a new surface in a health insurance line.**
**Verified information, all measured on 2026-09-27 from the PubMed utilities**:
**First, its starting point is a specific criticism of existing practice, and that criticism is itself a transferable modelling intuition.** The abstract states that most existing claims-based frailty indices rely primarily on diagnostic codes, which may overlook functional status reflected in healthcare utilisation. **Claims data carry at least two signal families: diagnostic codes say what disease a person has, while utilisation, meaning visit frequency, hospital days, and medication intensity, reflects whether the body is coping, so health or life risk stratification should list these two families separately before choosing which to use.**
**Second, its modelling path is stated clearly enough to copy, from a large candidate set through age-associated screening into an extreme gradient boosting model and finally to a sixty-three item index.** The abstract states that among more than a thousand candidate variables, age-associated items were identified and entered into an extreme gradient boosting model, internally validated by five-fold cross-validation, to predict a survey-based frailty index, yielding the final index, and it names that survey index as the reference standard. **This is the standard pattern for approximating an unobservable functional state with observable claims features, and its key requirement is an independently measured reference standard to compare against, since without one a study can claim correlation but not measurement accuracy.**
**Third, its results report both an absolute association and a relative gain over an established index.** The abstract gives an adjusted hazard ratio band with a confidence interval per increment of the index for mortality at one, three, and five years, notes that discrimination is comparable to the survey standard, and reports that discrimination exceeds an established multimorbidity frailty index by a stated difference in discrimination with a significance statement. **Reporting both the absolute association and the relative gain tells a reader how much better the new index actually is, whereas a single discrimination statistic does not.**
**Fourth, it states its reproducibility preconditions, including the year, size, and death count of each cohort.** The abstract names a development cohort from one year and a validation cohort from a later year with their sample sizes and death counts, and states that Cox models were adjusted for age, sex, and comorbidity burden. **Validating on a later year is a form of temporal external validation rather than a random split, which is closer to actual deployment and is worth preferring in model reports.**
**Fifth, metadata, provenance, and window status, including a retrieval convention for this surface.** The record gives an identifier, a journal name, a date line, an online ahead of print status, and a persistent identifier. **This round filtered the surface by its entry date rather than its publication date line, and the two can differ, since another in-window hit carried a publication date line far in the future while its entry date was inside the window, so citations should state which date is being used, in the same family as the earlier distinction between a registration date and a publication date.**
**Sixth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover premium structure in one national health insurance scheme, insurance industry statistics for that market, and a health insurance reserving handbook, **while this entry supplies the form of a machine learning frailty index built on a national claims database and validated against a survey instrument. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**
**For RIAA**: **five practices transfer: treat diagnosis and utilisation as two signal families; require a reference standard when using proxy variables; report absolute association and relative gain together; prefer a later-year validation cohort; and state whether the entry date or the publication date line is being used.**
**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, the paper text was not read, neither the model nor the data were obtained, and no result was reproduced**, so no claim is made about model performance, index construction, or clinical validity. **Second, only metadata and abstract returned by the record interface were read**, not the full text, which sits behind a subscription this entry did not attempt to bypass. **Third, the representativeness and external generalisability of the national claims sample were not verified. Fourth, the contents and availability of the sixty-three items were not verified. Fifth, the comparison against the established multimorbidity index was not verified in detail. Sixth, whether code or data can be requested was not verified. Seventh, the electronic publication date falls inside this round window against a baseline of the twenty-seventh of September, with the journal line showing an online-first article. Eighth, this entry records what was visible on that date and states plainly that it constitutes no medical, underwriting, or pricing advice.**

**可核實資訊（均 2026-09-27 PubMed E-utilities 實測）**：
**⭐⭐⭐ ① 起點是對既有做法的具體批評**——**逐字**Most existing claims-based frailty indices (CFIs) rely primarily on diagnostic codes, which may overlook functional status reflected in healthcare utilization.**；**⭐ 即**理賠數據至少有兩類信號：**診斷碼說得了什麼病**，**利用度（**就醫頻次、**住院天數、**用藥強度）**反映身體撐不撐得住**。
**⭐⭐ ② 建模路徑逐字清楚可抄**——**逐字**Among 1032 candidate variables, age-associated items were identified and entered into an extreme gradient boosting model (internally validated by 5-fold crossvalidation) to predict the SFI, yielding a 63-item CFI.** 與 **The TLSA survey-based frailty index (SFI) served as the reference standard.**；**⭐ 即**用可觀測的理賠特徵逼近不可觀測的功能狀態**，**關鍵是有獨立測量的參照標準**。
**⭐⭐ ③ 結果同時報絕對關聯與相對增益**——**逐字**adjusted HR 1.44-1.81, 95% C.I 1.31-2.31** 與 **ΔAUC ranging from 2.79% to 6.90%; P < 0.05**。
**⭐⭐ ④ 寫明可復現前提**——**逐字**The 2011 cohort (n = 3727) was used for development and the 2015 cohort (n = 5434) for validation.** 與 **723 and 580 deaths occurred in the development and validation cohorts, respectively.** 與 **Cox models adjusted for age, sex, and comorbidity burden**；**⭐ 即**用後來年度做驗證比隨機切分更接近實際部署**。
